goal: Refactor monolithic ingestion pipeline into separate streaming reader and batch writer workers

tasks.title: Audit Ingestion Socket and Stream Protocol
tasks.description: Inspect websocket connection handlers, buffer pooling, and backpressure behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Document current byte framing and max message limits
Identify dropped frame conditions under network spikes

tasks.title: Audit Database Batch Flush and WAL Write Patterns
tasks.description: Inspect batch insert sizes, connection pool timeouts, and lock contention.
acceptance_criteria: Record current transaction commit frequency and batch latencies
Identify table lock bottlenecks during bulk insert

tasks.title: Design Redis Streams Buffer Schema and Queue Contract
tasks.description: Specify binary message payload schema and consumer group acknowledgment protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Define stream key naming conventions and retention limits
Document consumer group acknowledgment and retry dead-letter policy

tasks.title: Implement Decoupled Stream Reader Worker
tasks.description: Write standalone async reader reading external sockets and appending to Redis stream.
acceptance_criteria: Zero database dependencies in reader process
Backpressure drops or pauses ingest cleanly when stream buffer exceeds limit

tasks.title: Implement Decoupled Batch Writer Worker
tasks.description: Write consumer worker reading Redis stream batches and issuing transactional bulk inserts.
acceptance_criteria: Batch inserts of up to 500 records per transaction
ACK stream messages only after successful database commit

tasks.title: End-to-End Pipeline Mock Ingestion Verification
tasks.description: Simulate 10,000 ingested events and verify zero data loss across reader and writer workers.
acceptance_criteria: 10,000 mock events ingested through reader and verified in test database
Worker crash and restart resumes stream without duplicates or drops
